Sterlite Technologies aims for ₹20,000 crore revenue by FY29

Sterlite Technologies, a broadband technology company, has set a target of achieving ₹20,000 crore in revenue by the fiscal year 2029. The company plans to achieve this through significant capacity expansion and by strengthening customer relationships to scale its digital connectivity business internationally. The company's stock saw a 5% surge.
